question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Whose story did you like better?
Did you get the good ending the first time through?
options: No, I got the bad ending.

nodes.text: Both guys lay in a heap next to the pig, panting...
Colt grabs the blanket and waves it in front of the pig's face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This isn't working!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know it isn't working because I can still feel pig spit on my leg!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. Pig spit!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not helping!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Take off your pants!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's the only way, man!
Ben unbuttons his pants and slips out of them, freeing himself from the pig.

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt grabs the teddy bear and shakes it in front of the pig's face! It makes a rattling sound!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who's a good piggy?
The pig lets go of Ben's pant leg and bites on the teddy bear!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grab the what?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The... Um... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're taking too long!
Crawling across the carpet, Ben tries to get away, but the pig bites Ben's pant leg!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Squeeeeeeeeee!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Squeeeeeeeeee![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How do I turn off its alarm?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Get it off of my leg!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Distract it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's a pig gnawing my leg! Why are you asking so many questions?!
Ben looks around the den and sees a blanket next to a stuffed teddy bear...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grab the...
Ben tries to leap over the pig, but the pig's body is too large! His shoes clip the pig's back, and Ben topples forward on top of it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Grnnt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grnnt![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben drops into a fetal position! The pig stops in front of him, sniffing at his face...

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Prft! Prft! Prft!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Prft! Prft! Prft![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben can't help himself and starts laughing!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That tickles!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben freezes, and the pig slams into him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink! Oink!`
The pig races out of the kitchen, oinking its way down the hall!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, Tweed... Let me check my pig-rustling handbook!
Ben gets out his phone and calls Hector... Hector's voicemail picks up...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What up?! Leave a message! And if you're Ben, all I can say is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry! There was a mix-up and Amanda wouldn't let me near it and anyway...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just bring it to the party, and I'll owe you big time!
Ben hangs up and takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've got to get it under control first if we're going to get it to the party!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're serious? You want us to bring `that thing` back with us?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're serious? You want us to bring [color=#e23b3b][i]that thing[/i][/color] back with us?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I don't come back with a pig, the party's over before it starts!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And from what I saw at the beach between you and Denni, if you don't come back `with me,` you're in a lot of hot water!
nodes.text_bbcode: And from what I saw at the beach between you and Denni, if you don't come back [color=#e23b3b][i]with me,[/i][/color] you're in a lot of hot water!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what's your bright idea then?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come with me!
The two guys creep into the den...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Do you see it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You've got eyes, too! Do you see a gigantic pig monster anywhere?

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The guys jump as the pig charges into the room from behind!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `AHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `AHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The pig chases them around the den! Colt leaps onto the ping pong table!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The pig whirls toward Ben, charging at him! Ben's trapped! All he can do is...
Ben freezes, screaming as the pig barrels towards him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The pig slams into him, knocking him over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... Other than a bruised ego...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That might be your sternum...
Ben dives up onto the countertop next to Colt, lifting his legs at the last second!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Amen to that...
Ben freezes, screaming as the pig barrels towards him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The pig slams into him, knocking him over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... Other than a bruised ego...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That might be your sternum...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've already wasted too much time, and I can't miss the second ferry!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Princess will probably kill me if I don't show up...
Ben unlocks the front door, and they step in...
Inside, the house has an odd smell to it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yuck... Hector's cologne's gotten a lot worse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Smells like the backside of a barn.
Ben pops open the refrigerator...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?! It's empty!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. You got pranked.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This isn't a prank, Colt. Having no food at the party doesn't benefit anyone!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The only question is... If Hector didn't put the pig in the fridge, where did he put it?

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink! Oink!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no...
Just then, a massive pig comes charging into the kitchen!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?!
Colt dives onto the counter, lifting his legs up just in time as the pig charges past him and right at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But you're interested in her?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Er... That's not what I meant!
Colt jabs his finger in Ben's chest repeatedly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What exactly did you mean, Tweed?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stop that! We're not interested in each other!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure you aren't!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine! Don't believe me! See if I care!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... That's water long under the bridge. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So you'll stay away from her?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As a suitor, yes. As a friend, no.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can accept that. Except for the suitor part. I don't like the idea of you trying to dress up Princess in formal clothes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's weird!
Ben sighs.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh really? Because the way you hesitated just now worries me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was just going to say that Denni isn't interested in me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's settled then! You guys have fun!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not coming with us?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nope! You've gotta bond! Be mature about it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mature?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt can't be mature!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up, Tweed.
The line moves and both Ben and Colt watch with trepidation as Denni leaves them, heading toward the ferry.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Bye, guys! Have fun!
A few minutes later, Ben and Colt watch as the ferry sails off, bound for the island.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great. It's my big party, and I'm not even there.
They walk toward the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who cares about a dumb party, Tweed?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I do! This is a big opportunity for me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: An opportunity to do what? Make your lameness even more public?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... It's a chance to finally put all of that awful stuff that happened with Jessica behind me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just want to have fun. To re-connect with my friends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So then this party is part of some stupid Save Ben campaign?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not stupid, and yeah, kind of... I'm going to throw some sweet parties, pull some epic pranks, maybe change my look again...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You ask me, you try too hard.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I didn't ask you. Besides, why do you care?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're a real inspiration, you know that? Let's just get this over with...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The sooner we get the pig, the less we'll have to deal with each other.
In the parking lot, they reach Colt's motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I forgot that you don't have an actual car.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! She gets the job done.
Colt hops on the bike, and Ben sits in the seat behind him. Colt calls over his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You put your arms around my waist, and you're roadkill, got it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got it... Uh... Where `do` I put my...
nodes.text_bbcode: Got it... Uh... Where [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] I put my...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Figure it out!
Colt revs the bike's engine and peels out of the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `AAAHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AAAHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Twenty harrowing minutes later, Ben and Colt arrive at Hector's place...
As soon as the bike comes to a stop, Ben leaps off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you have to drive so fast?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Do you have to scream in my ear?! You sound like my sister!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, did I do something recently to upset you? Because you're acting jerkier than usual...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is this about the arms around the waist thing?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Never mind! Forgive me for actually trying to communicate with you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You want to communicate? Answer this. Are you looking for another girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... What? I guess... I mean, if the right girl comes along...
Colt marches around the bike and jabs a finger in Ben's chest.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then stay away from Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni?
Realization washes over Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that what this is about?! You have no reason to worry...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's low on my summer bucket list, but Tiny Hipster here is pretty insistent that you and I hang out...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At least you're honest about it...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm pressed for time, so I guess I'll take you up on your forced offer.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you are?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Um... You obviously don't want to give me a ride, so I'll just get one with someone else.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, Tweed. Good luck with that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? He's being dumb.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Be nice!
Ben tries to get a ride from some of the other people in line, but all of them are intent on taking the ferry...
He returns, dejected, to Colt and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Still cool?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... Can I still take you up on your offer?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know...
Denni punches Colt in the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stop doing that!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop being a jerk, and I will!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The offer still stands, Tweed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now, follow me! You can hang out with me and the cheerleaders...
$ZOE leads Sam back to the beach, where the cheerleaders are hanging out and talking...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...But Jessica did leave behind one good thing...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Are you talking about the Dirty Dish?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You're obsessed with that site!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That site's still going?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Of course! It's where `all` the juicy gossip is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! It's where [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the juicy gossip is!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: In fact, if I had dirt on someone, `that's` where I'd post it!
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, if I had dirt on someone, [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] where I'd post it!

nodes.text: A thought enters Sam's head... She looks at Sara and Nick on the other side of the crowd...
And a smile plays at the corner of her lips...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See, Sam? I told you this would be fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Things are definitely looking up...
Meanwhile, as the party guys are finishing up their checklist, Hector arrives with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She was standing in between the cheerleaders and the swim team!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I didn't know where to go!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sounds like you're wearing too many hats, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: How many am I wearing now?!
The ferry boat blasts its horn! Ferry workers unclasp the ropes leading onto the boat, and the line starts to move!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Still worried about something going wrong, Carson?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not at all! It seems we've covered all the angles! We truly are a `perfect` party team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not at all! It seems we've covered all the angles! We truly are a [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect[/i][/color] party team!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, and I can't wait to taste some of that roast pig Hector brought...
Hector stops in his tracks...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, guys, how important is the roast pig?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You mean the only source of food we brought other than celery sticks?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't tell me...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You forgot the pig?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... I forgot the pig.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Why did I say 'perfect'?! I knew it was a jinx!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We can't have a luau without food!
Amanda wanders off toward the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mermaid club! Woop! Woop!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys, I have to watch Amanda... Can one of you go back to my place for the pig?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You'll still have time to catch the second ferry boat...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I can't. Once we get on the island, I've got, like, a hundred hula skirts to hand out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And I've got music to deal with. Without my playlist, there won't be any island rhythms!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks, bro!
Hector tosses Ben the keys to his place. A strange look comes over his face.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: One small detail...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Never mind. You'll do fine!
Hector pats Ben on the shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... I don't have a ride.
Just then, Denni and Colt are walking past the guys...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! You know who'd love to give you a ride? Colt!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He would?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I would?
Denni nudges Colt in the ribs...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Remember what we talked about!
Colt sighs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine. Tweed, you want a ride?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's kind of superficial, isn't it, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not really looking for a boyfriend right now...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, yeah, I am being superficial. I just want to have fun, that's all! It's a party!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I guess there's not much harm in fun...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, sure!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But he can't be anything like Nick, got it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got it... Are you sure this is a good idea? You might not be ready...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm ready to talk to a guy, $ZOE. Just bring me a nice guy who isn't Nick... That shouldn't be too hard, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why do we need a checklist?! There's nothing to worry about! Ferry boat... Check! Peeps... Check! Island... Check and checkmate! Party time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'll work on this, Hector. You just concentrate on making sure Amanda boards the ferry.
As Ben, Carson, and $Scott go over their checklist, Hector wanders across the beach in search of Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Life's not bad when the only thing you have to worry about is a smoking hot, directionally challenged redhead...
He walks right by Colt and Denni, who are having their own discussion about the party.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Princess, how about we skip this goofshow, go for a late ride on my bike, make out, get some grub, have a make out encore, and call it a night?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: For the last time, `no!` You are not getting out of this!
nodes.text_bbcode: For the last time, [color=#3b78e2][i]no![/i][/color] You are not getting out of this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I am, you know, `me,` so I can always just `Colt` my way out of it.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am, you know, [color=#e23b3b][i]me,[/i][/color] so I can always just [color=#e23b3b][i]Colt[/i][/color] my way out of it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! No getting out of it, no sneaking out of it, and definitely no Colting out of it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why are you so bent on dragging me to this thing anyway?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because Ben's throwing the party, and he's my friend! That means I'm going to support him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And you're my boyfriend, so that means you have to do 'horrible' boyfriend things... Like get dragged to a really fun party `on an island!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And you're my boyfriend, so that means you have to do 'horrible' boyfriend things... Like get dragged to a really fun party [color=#3b78e2][i]on an island![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But Tweed is so... Tweedy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That literally means nothing. What do you have against Ben?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And before you answer, think about how nice Ben is. He's also really vulnerable, considering he just went through a crazy hard break up. Plus he also kinda saved my life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I get it. Tweed's perfect! Why don't you date him again?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, I `thought` we talked about this... I don't have any feelings for Ben.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] we talked about this... I don't have any feelings for Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or do you only hear me when I say I want to make out with you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hear you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you saying you want to make out?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whatever, Colt. Sooner or later, you're going to have to realize that if you want to be with me, you're going to have to be friends with Ben.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Friends? With Tweed? I'd rather punch my own face.
Meanwhile, in another part of the crowd, Sam starts to head over toward the swim team, but stops when she sees Nick standing there with his camera...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Can I take some pictures of all of you?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sure! Me first!
Hannah smiles, and Nick takes a picture!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks! That's a good one.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Of course it is! I don't really have a bad side!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Linda, how about one with you and Jane together?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Just make sure if you post this online, you don't say anything about girl power! We're athletes, okay? Our gender isn't relevant!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Got it... Girls aren't relevant.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: What'd you say?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Totally kidding! Just a joke!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Watch yourself, Brown!
Nick turns to Sara...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, and... One of you, Sara?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sure...
Nick takes a picture of Sara. He looks at it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, your smile's so pretty!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I mean, er... All of these are pretty! You girls are pretty!

nodes.speaker: Nick

nodes.text: I don't know... Anyway, he's saving up money to buy his own inn, `The Innie!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... Anyway, he's saving up money to buy his own inn, [color=#e23b3b][i]The Innie![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And how much fake money do you have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: To be honest... None. I spent it all on a magical donkey, but I haven't seen any of the fruits of my labor...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just a lot of magical donkey dung...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hee hee... You're kind of funny, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Weird, but funny.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For distracting me... Even for just a little while...
On the island, $ZOE approaches Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, this is...
Sam has failed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't the way my cousin behaves... You've got to calm down!
Sam looks at the message... The SEND key glows temptingly in front of her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're crazy if you think I'm stealing a boat!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, you want to be cool, Tweed? This is how. You don't need to have some Cool Guy strategy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You just need a boat, so you take one. And guess what? Showing up in our `own` boat is crazy cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: You just need a boat, so you take one. And guess what? Showing up in our [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] boat is crazy cool.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was `my idea!` Colt didn't have anything to do with it!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#e23b3b][i]my idea![/i][/color] Colt didn't have anything to do with it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Tweed, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Colt? You mean the kid we've already got a full rap sheet on? If he didn't have anything to do with this, I'm a concert pianist.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, then I'd like to hear you play because I'm telling the truth!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know it's an unlikely scenario, but I bet you didn't expect us to have a pig with us when you stopped us, did you?

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well... No...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unlikely scenarios `can` happen, and this is one of them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlikely scenarios [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] happen, and this is one of them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tweed! You don't know what you're doing...
Ben ignores Colt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Officer, this party is mine. I missed the ferry. I was desperate to get across, but I couldn't watch my pig `and` operate this boat.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Officer, this party is mine. I missed the ferry. I was desperate to get across, but I couldn't watch my pig [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] operate this boat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt was walking by, so I flagged him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not how it happened.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt was riding by on his motorcycle, looking super cool, then I flagged him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I do remember something in his past about a motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, I told him I'd compensate him for taking the trip with me, but he didn't know I was stealing the boat... I told him it was mine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm telling you, that's not what happened!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me the real story, Colt?
Colt starts to talk, but then he looks at Ben...
And something in him gives...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Tweed's right. That's... That's how it happened...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This story stinks like a... Like a pig in a boat!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: Oink!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A second ago you were disagreeing with him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never thought you'd believe that I had nothing to do with it... I figured I'd at least try to get `him` free...
nodes.text_bbcode: I never thought you'd believe that I had nothing to do with it... I figured I'd at least try to get [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] free...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You gotta believe me. Don't send an innocent kid to juvenile hall.
Monte stares hard at Ben and Colt...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fine. You seem like a good kid, so I'll believe you. Even though I don't know what kind of a name 'Tweed' is...
The officer looks at Colt...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You can go... But... I'll be keeping an eye out for you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
The officer handcuffs Ben and escorts him onto the Coast Guard ship. The boat heads back to the mainland...
Nearby, Sam looks at the message she's typed out on her phone...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe Ben did that for Colt... It was so stupid and... And unselfish.
Suddenly the message Sam's written seems petty and utterly wrong.
Without another moment's hesitation, she deletes the message.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll never even `think` about doing something like that again!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll never even [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] about doing something like that again!

nodes.text: After word of what happened travels around the island, Denni comes up to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben really got taken away?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, and it wasn't even his fault... I mean... I didn't think we were gonna get caught!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not pissed off at me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You were just being you... And I know you took the boat because you thought coming to the party was important to me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Granted, it wasn't your `finest` hour...
nodes.text_bbcode: Granted, it wasn't your [color=#3b78e2][i]finest[/i][/color] hour...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry... I'll try not to kick you while you're down...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's going to happen to Ben?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't think it'll be too bad for him... Just a fine and some community service.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, that's not that bad...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Kind of a `friendly` thing for him to do, wasn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Kind of a [color=#3b78e2][i]friendly[/i][/color] thing for him to do, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I hear you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course, Princess! Let's go make out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sigh. Sure.
Looks like Ben's actions inspired Sam to do the right thing and eased friction between him and Colt.
You played a great game! You helped Sam stay calm in a tough situation, you helped Ben make a tremendous sacrifice...
And weird as it is, you also managed to help Ben escort a huge pig to an island party! Great job!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It wasn't my idea! It was Colt's!
Ben points his finger at Colt's face!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And what? You were just along for the ride?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I knew it was wrong, but I'm not a troublemaker...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If it weren't for Colt, I never would have gotten on the boat in the first place...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Colt? You've got quite a reputation. I bet what this guy's saying is true, isn't it?
Colt looks at Ben, who stares at him pleadingly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Tweed didn't do anything wrong.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Very well, then... You're free to go, son.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, piggy!
Ben takes the pig and runs off, leaving Colt behind.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're the one we want anyway, Colt. Quite a rap sheet. You'll be going to juvie for a `long` time...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're the one we want anyway, Colt. Quite a rap sheet. You'll be going to juvie for a [color=#e23b3b][i]long[/i][/color] time...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shove it, will you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ben just completely abandoned Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just confirms what I already knew... People are the worst!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's it!
Sam presses the SEND key, submitting her post to the Dirty Dish...
A few minutes later, word has spread all over the island...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe someone would do this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe it's not so bad... I mean, your dad's a little out of touch... Maybe he won't find out about it...
A second later, Sara's phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no... It's him...
Nearby, Sam watches on gleefully... She turns... And runs right into $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it was you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? Consider us through!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Through? We're family! It's not like you can break up with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I just did! Don't ever talk to me again! Goodbye!
$ZOE marches away!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE...
Sam looks back at the sad faces of Sara and Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I went a little too far... But it's too late now...
Too late indeed! With Colt going to juvie, Nick and Sara on the verge of breaking up, and $ZOE disowning Sam, you might have guessed it...
This isn't the Good Ending! Play again and see if you can help Ben and Sam with both of their situations!

nodes.text: Ben and Colt come to a slow pace as they near the island's dock...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What'd I tell you, Tweed? Nothing to it! `Perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What'd I tell you, Tweed? Nothing to it! [color=#e23b3b][i]Perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A voice blares on a megaphone behind them!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: This is the Coast Guard!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Water cops!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: You are operating a stolen boat. Power down your motor and prepare to be boarded!
Colt turns the motor off...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to be okay, right? I mean, you can Colt your way out of this, right? Smooth talk the Coast Guard... Right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Fraid not, Tweed...
Colt buries his head in his hands.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm dead, man. I've got a record. I might have to go to juvie for this...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean... Boot Camp?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I mean, like, prison for kids...
Sam arrives at the docks once again, her phone out, the message to The Dirty Dish typed and ready to be sent...
She's about to press SEND, when she notices Ben and Colt talking to the Coast Guard!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You boys are in a lot of trouble...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This guy, really? He's everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't understand, sir...
Meanwhile, at the island party...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not having any fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! But Sam, there are tiki torches and drinks in coconuts and...
A song with steel drums melodiously wafts through a nearby set of speakers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...And island rhythms!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, that's all great! But there's also Nick and Sara laughing and flirting with each other `everywhere` I go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that's all great! But there's also Nick and Sara laughing and flirting with each other [color=#3b78e2][i]everywhere[/i][/color] I go!

nodes.text: A couple yards away, Nick playfully touches Sara's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hee! That sounds like a really funny picture!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The only thing that would make this worse would be some kind of lame ice-breaker game like...
Carson bounds into their midst...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Who's up for Truth or Volleyball? It's a new twist on an old favorite!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh...
A few minutes later, Sam, $ZOE, and the cheerleaders are standing on the opposite side of a net from Nick, Sara, and the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You sure you want to be on that side, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Positive. Let's get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We'll start with Jill...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay... Uh... Nick... Truth or Volleyball?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Truth!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay... Do you have feelings for someone on this court right now?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh! Juicy! I bet he's still got feelings for Sam!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I do have feelings for `someone...` Yeah.
nodes.text_bbcode: I do have feelings for [color=#e23b3b][i]someone...[/i][/color] Yeah.

nodes.text: Everyone gasps!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I love this game. Hannah, you're up!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sam! Truth or Volleyball?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Volleyball.
Hannah takes the ball and hits it over the net... Jill digs it out, Maria sets it for Sam, and Sam coils her arm back to spike it at...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's go throw Hector into the ocean...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No argument from me there.
The pig rolls over onto its side.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me with this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't kid yourself, Tweed. I'm not doing this for you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really? After all that? You're `still` against me?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? After all that? You're [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] against me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's get this straight... I don't care about you. I don't care about your break up with Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't care about your Faceplace friends or the fact that you didn't become President!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I don't care about your party! The two of us herding a pig together doesn't make us friends.

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't want my girlfriend's ex talking to my girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine! Then you know what? Let's just stop talking altogether.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This way, there's no danger of us becoming friends, and we won't be wasting any time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You can hate me all you want behind Denni's back, and I'll actually get to attend my party.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine by me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But it's not like anyone's going to have fun there anyway...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you serious? Who isn't having fun at an `island` party?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious? Who isn't having fun at an [color=#e23b3b][i]island[/i][/color] party?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Beaten by a pig... That's embarrassing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not as embarrassing as those tighty-whiteys.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Real mature, Colt.

nodes.text: Ben, Hector, $Scott, and Carson stand together on the pier that extends from Centerscore Beach...
On the sand nearby, a crowd of students waits in line, preparing to board a huge ferry boat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gentlemen, we've pooled together our respective party prowesses to throw a truly magnificent gala!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Or...` Smaller words. We're about to be hosts to the Best Party of `All Time!` Boom! Coined it!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Or...[/i][/color] Smaller words. We're about to be hosts to the Best Party of [color=#e23b3b][i]All Time![/i][/color] Boom! Coined it!

nodes.text: Heh. These summer parties are so easy to plan with you guys. This one's going to be `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. These summer parties are so easy to plan with you guys. This one's going to be [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Carson shakes his head...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know how you guys convinced Prissy to let you throw a party on her dad's island, but this is awesome! I'm going to miss partying with my bros!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We will too, man! Hector, have we done everything we need to do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All we have left is herding these peeps onto the ferry boats to the island, and then it's a lock for luau. Nothing can go wrong! It's `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All we have left is herding these peeps onto the ferry boats to the island, and then it's a lock for luau. Nothing can go wrong! It's [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `AHH!` Are you guys insane?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color] Are you guys insane?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Carson? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not at all! Don't you know the laws of jinxing?! Every time you call something perfect, you jinx it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Or have none of you thrown a party before?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've `all` thrown parties.
nodes.text_bbcode: We've [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] thrown parties.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Then I don't need to remind you that something `always` goes wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I don't need to remind you that something [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] goes wrong!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But nothing will this time! So we're golden! We `are` perfect!
nodes.text_bbcode: But nothing will this time! So we're golden! We [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] perfect!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `AHHHH!` Stop that! I guarantee you... We're forgetting something.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHH![/i][/color] Stop that! I guarantee you... We're forgetting something.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, man...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm glad someone has some sense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, we totally forgot...
